header.reason: Ines, the new CFO, signed once Wen priced her team's hand-matching of deposits using her own statements. Dana pitched a portal deal, but the real buy was a faster month-end close.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with the slow month-end close, not online checkout.

line.text: Stripe automates the tedious parts of revenue reporting and reconciliation, so teams spend less time closing the books

findings.why: Ines's first close took nine days, partly from two people matching deposits by hand.
findings.quote: her first month-end close took nine days

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Open the proposal with what hand-matching costs the finance team.

line.text: Automatic reconciliation compares order-level data with Stripe transactions and bank deposits

findings.why: Ines read page one of the portal-focused proposal and dismissed it, stalling the deal three weeks.
findings.quote: she read the first page and said it wasn't her problem

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Lead with the close problem, not lower card costs, against bank offers.

line.text: Businesses on custom interchange pricing can lower card processing costs by up to 3.3%

findings.why: The bank answered Ines with a rate review she hadn't asked for. Dana never saw Fiserv's pitch.
findings.quote: I didn't ask about my rates.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace 'global growth' with payout-to-transaction matching in the opening.
findings.why: The standard deck got silence from Paul. Ines stopped Wen at payout reconciliation to see it again.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a wholesale distributor customer story about matching deposits to invoices.
findings.why: Ines brushed off a retail case study and raised the missing distributor reference twice.
findings.quote: this is a company that sells sweaters.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Use 'where my money is' and 'deposits' instead of 'infrastructure'.
findings.why: Ines said 'the deposits', never 'payments', and nobody at Tallowfield said 'infrastructure'.
findings.quote: I just want to know where my money is.
